EnclaveSaveState.title: EnclaveSaveState
EnclaveSaveState.description: Stores a player's Enclave of the 16 3D sandbox simulation timeline, POV relay progress, project telemetry, and chronicle logs.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user owning this save state.

relayStep.description: Current Rashomon POV relay step within the day (1 to 3, or 4 for Grand Feast).

activePovId.description: Identifier of the currently active POV genius character.

colonyMorale.description: Overall Enclave family morale and cohesion score (0 to 100).

gatesTraversed.description: Total number of 3D Choice Gates walked through across the campaign.

statePayloadJson.description: Serialized state snapshot of character stress, Grand Project progress, and Black Market queue.

lastSummary.description: Human-readable summary of the latest choice gate or Grand Feast outcome.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the save record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the save record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/enclave_saves/{saveId}.description: Per-user collection storing Enclave 16 3D sandbox saves and timeline telemetry.
